Container.Name: CrownJukebox-Backend
Container.Overview: CrownJukebox Backend — Go API server with SQLite database. Handles music scanning, album art extraction, queue and playback state. Deploy this BEFORE the frontend container. Point MUSIC_DIR at your music library (MP3, FLAC, OGG supported).

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Path to your music folder on the Unraid array. MP3, FLAC and OGG are supported. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: App Data (database)
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (crownjukebox.db) is stored. Use a path on your cache or array.

Config.Name: Artwork Cache
Config.Description: Where extracted album art thumbnails are cached. Can be on the cache drive for speed.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Backend API port. The frontend container uses this to communicate with the backend. Set BACKEND_URL in the frontend template to http://[IP]:[this port].

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Username for the admin account. Created automatically on first start.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password/PIN for the admin account. Change this before first start!

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Secret key used to sign session tokens. Use a long random string. NEVER share this.

Config.Name: Session Lifetime (hours)
Config.Description: How long a user session lasts in hours. Default is 168 (7 days).

Config.Name: Subsonic URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL to a Subsonic/Navidrome server for extended library support. Leave empty to use local music folder only.

Config.Name: Subsonic Username
Config.Description: Username for the Subsonic/Navidrome server (only needed if SUBSONIC_URL is set).

Config.Name: Subsonic Password
Config.Description: Password for the Subsonic/Navidrome server (only needed if SUBSONIC_URL is set).

Config.Name: DB Path (internal)
Config.Description: Internal path to the SQLite database file. Change only if you know what you are doing.

Config.Name: Music Dir (internal)
Config.Description: Internal container path for the music library. Must match the Music Library volume target above.

Config.Name: Artwork Cache Dir (internal)
Config.Description: Internal container path for the artwork cache. Must match the Artwork Cache volume target above.
